entities.name: Ad'Amra
entities.description: Human warrior and blue spellcaster from The Domains, daughter of Red Donald, unrequitedly in love with Chromium Rhuell.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Ad'Amra's father, a military commander killed at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: Elder Dragon who lived disguised as Ham of the council; Ad'Amra's unrequited love.

entities.name: Arcus
entities.description: Of the High Council of Mors Ridge; taught Ad'Amra blue magic.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Elder Dragon, sister of Chromium, awakened at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: Elder Dragon killed long ago, Chromium's lost love.

entities.name: High Council of Mors Ridge
entities.description: Council of mages at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Spell of Making
entities.description: Blue spell Ad'Amra learned and used to distract Palladia-Mors.

events.summary: Ad'Amra learned blue magic from Arcus and fell in love with Ham of the council.
events.quote: There, she fell in love with Ham of the council.

events.summary: Ad'Amra became general of the Army of the Valley when Palladia-Mors awoke and the Battle at Mors Ridge began.
events.quote: Ad'Amra became general of the Army of the Valley when Palladia-Mors was awakened

events.summary: Orcs and undead attacked the town and killed Red Donald.
events.quote: The town was attacked by a horde of orcs and undead, killing Red Donald .

events.summary: Ham revealed himself as Palladia's brother, the Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell.
events.quote: Ham revealed himself to be Palladia's brother, the Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell

events.summary: Ad'Amra used the Spell of Making to distract Palladia-Mors so Chromium could cast a renewed stasis spell on her.
events.quote: Ad'Amra used the Spell of Making to distract Palladia-Mors so that Chromium could cast a renewed stasis spell on his sister

events.summary: Ad'Amra tracked Chromium to his lair, where he again rejected her love and flew off.
events.quote: Again, he rejected her love and flew off across the skies

relations.quote: known as the daughter of Red Donald
tragic and unrequited love for Chromium Rhuell
She began to learn blue magic from Arcus of the High Council of Mors Ridge
